name: Mega Man 64 Recompiled
description:
Mega Man 64 Recompiled is a native PC port of Mega Man 64 (the Nintendo 64 release of Mega Man Legends), created via static recompilation. It brings the beloved 3D action-adventure into native 64-bit Linux.

Features:
- Native PC rendering with high-resolution scaling and smooth uncapped framerates
- True widescreen display support and modern camera angle controls
- Modern dual-analog gamepad and keyboard/mouse control configurations
- Crisp audio reproduction with remastered sound capabilities
- Full preservation of the original 3D dungeon crawling, town exploration, and boss battles
